dedupe_keys.name: a database of cone penetration tests from north america

description: A Database of Cone Penetration Tests from North America is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Morgan Sanger, University of Washington (washington.edu). This dataset contains 1839 cone penetration test (CPT) results from across North America. This is the second version of this dataset, at the same DOI, where the first version contained 984 CPTs. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (MAT, PKL, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gqjm-t836. Keywords: cone penetration test,  subsurface characterization,  geotechnical data,  soil liquefaction. Published 2024-10-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
